core_aesthetic_takeaways: This batch is strongest for high-saturation retail packaging and fashion-resale identity systems.
The transferable visual DNA is purple-yellow identity contrast, kraft logistics material, triangular logo grammar, and dark boutique signage.
It adds a louder and more experimental retail direction to the existing quiet luxury and civic VI training sets.
The strongest images for future generation are the grouped packaging system and the open-bag interior color views.
The dark storefront images are useful for atmosphere but should be separated from packaging still-life prompts.
prompt_structure_lessons: Name the medium first: shopping bag, kraft mailer, tissue, strap, storefront sign, or window decal.
Lock the color hierarchy: purple exterior, yellow logo, green or red interior accent, kraft brown logistics support.
Describe the triangle logo as a clean geometric identity mark, not as a generic warning sign.
Separate exact project text from third-party fashion-brand names.
For dark retail scenes, specify readable signage and one spotlight focal zone.

blocked_text_targets: third-party luxury fashion brand names visible on side panels
text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use third-party brand lists only as side-panel placement risk, not exact text.

risk_controls.mitigation: Exclude visible luxury-brand lists from generation targets and captions that request exact text.
Use purple-yellow as a domain-specific retail style, not as a universal palette for all brands.

risk_controls.risk: visual clutter in packaging still life
risk_controls.mitigation: Separate bag, box, strap, tissue, and storefront prompts by view_type.
Keep dark-scene prompts focused on one lit plaque or window logo, with readable contrast.

risk_controls.risk: triangle mark becoming generic warning signage
risk_controls.mitigation: Caption triangle as a fashion-retail identity mark with C-hi geometry and controlled brand placement.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: include as a high-value positive VI and packaging case after rights review
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: teach saturated retail packaging, material hierarchy, and trademark text exclusion
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: train as a fashion-retail packaging/signage subset rather than mixing directly with civic VI

negative_prompt_atoms: dirty kraft texture as main style
random shopping bags without identity system
